Getting Here
✈
From Incheon Airport
Airport Bus 6770: Incheon Airport → Gwangmyeong Station (direct)
Or Taxi direct to venue (approx. 40–50 min, ₩50,000–60,000)
🚇
From Seoul City
KTX / Subway Line 1 → Gwangmyeong Station, Exit 1·2 → 10-min walk toward IKEA
Free shuttle from Exit 1 (every 15 min, from 1 hour before the ceremony)
🚗
By Car / Taxi
Navigation: "La Casa Tower" (라까사타워). Free parking in the hotel garage (approx. 300 cars).
